description:
FILED s473w (Opus, 2026-09-09) from the #1502 CPAN-board census.

`IO::Socket::UNIX` calls `AF_UNIX` (imported from Socket) and PCL dies

    Undefined subroutine &IO::Socket::UNIX::AF_UNIX called

so any program that so much as LOADS IO::Socket::UNIX is lost.  On the board
that is Data-Dump t/glob.t, FAIL 0/0 where perl gives 6 rows â the file merely
dumps a socket handle among its globs.

REPRODUCE:
    tools/run-dist-t.pl ~/.cpan/build/Data-Dump-1.25-0 t/glob.t
and, smaller:
    perl -e 'use IO::Socket::UNIX; print "loaded\n"'   # perl: loaded
    ./runpcl <the same as a file>                      # PCL: dies

LAYER (CLAUDE.md 9a): `Socket` is a core module with an XS half, and PCL has
`lib/Socket.pm` as a shim.  The constant is a MODULE FACT, so the fix is in
that shim's export list / constant table, not in the parser or runtime.  Check
what `lib/Socket.pm` exports today against what `IO::Socket::UNIX` imports
(`AF_UNIX`, `PF_UNIX`, `SOCK_STREAM`, `SOCK_DGRAM`, `SOMAXCONN`, â¦) and add the
missing ones with their platform values â the same way the shim already
carries the AF_INET family.

CHEAP AND WORTH IT: one shim edit, one guard row, six board rows.
subject: lib/Socket.pm does not export AF_UNIX, so loading IO::Socket::UNIX dies "Undefined subroutine &IO::Socket::UNIX::AF_UNIX" â one shim edit; Data-Dump glob.t is FAIL 0/0 behind it (perl 6/0)
